item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "c5f5a4ef07c73762228075ba1f68e24a295800b15646c7acc5dd33c1aae3a1f4",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "A type of systems indexed by two real constants K and ρ. Together with the supplied constructor D008 and projections D002–D003, it packages ρ ≠ 0, real-valued functions p and u of two real arguments, and the condition D009 at every pair of arguments.",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantification over system supplies the functions and their globally imposed first-order differential equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "The second field of a system, a function p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the pressure function in both linear combinations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "The third field of a system, a function u : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the velocity function in both linear combinations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for the derivative-based transport predicate D007.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each conjunct requires existence of the two slice derivatives and their transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "The function (x,t) ↦ p(x,t) − (ρc)u(x,t).",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the function in the second conjunct, whose transport speed is −c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "The function (x,t) ↦ p(x,t) + (ρc)u(x,t).",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the function in the first conjunct, whose transport speed is c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "For q : ℝ → ℝ → E in a real normed vector space, speed s and point (x,t), there exist a,b ∈ E such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative a at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative b at x, and a + s • b = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specializes to E = ℝ, where scalar multiplication is multiplication, giving q_t + s q_x = 0 with actual derivative witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "Constructs a system from a proof that ρ ≠ 0, functions p,u : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, and a proof that D009 holds for every real x,t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Exposes the nonzero-density condition and the globally quantified differential assumptions carried by the system.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "LocalDef009",
      "meaning": "At (x,t), there exist real numbers p_t,p_x,u_t,u_x that are respectively the time and space slice derivatives of p and u, with p_t + K u_x = 0 and u_t + ρ⁻¹ p_x = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "The system requires these four derivatives and both equations at every point; these are the differential hypotheses underlying the conclusions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "LocalDef010",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication by real numbers is jointly continuous on every real normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity instance needed to express D007 using HasDerivAt; adds no hypothesis on the functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "LocalDef011",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on ℝ is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a structural instance for the real-valued derivative assertions in the system.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both transport conclusions, and all derivative and equation clauses inside each predicate, to hold together.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation from a division-and-inversion monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects real division in K/ρ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts and applies the division operation supplied by an HDiv instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the real quotient K/ρ under the square root.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Extracts the strict comparison relation from an LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses 0 < K and 0 < ρ using the real strict order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Neg.neg",
      "meaning": "Extracts the unary negation operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the speed in the second transport equation equal to −√(K/ρ).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in its target type through the corresponding instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed numeral 0 as real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All parameters, coordinates, function values, speeds and derivative witnesses in the target are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "The real multiplicative structure with inversion and division satisfying a/b = a b⁻¹.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the arithmetic meaning of K/ρ; the positivity assumption excludes a zero denominator.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order instance on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the parameter assumptions ordinary strict positivity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Real.instNeg",
      "meaning": "The additive negation operation on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the negative speed and the negation used in subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero element of ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the zero in parameter comparisons and real differential equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Real.sqrt",
      "meaning": "Maps a real number to its nonnegative part, takes the nonnegative square root there, and returns the result as a real number; it is zero on negative inputs.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines c = √(K/ρ). Here K/ρ > 0, so c > 0 and c² = K/ρ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's zero element to interpret the numeral 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the literal zero in the assumptions to real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Promotes a division operation on one type to the corresponding homogeneous HDiv operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the quotient notation uses real division.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts and applies the addition operation of an HAdd instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the sums in w₊ and in the differential equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts and applies the multiplication operation of an HMul instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms (ρc)u, K u_x and ρ⁻¹ p_x.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts and applies the subtraction operation of an HSub instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms w₋ = p − (ρc)u.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Makes a normed field a normed vector space over itself using its multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specializes D007 to the standard real normed vector space ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes all real sums as ordinary addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "The real multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes products of coefficients, function values and derivative values as ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction defined by a − b = a + (−b).",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the minus sign in w₋.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The standard normed additive commutative group structure on ℝ, with its real norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the normed additive structure for real derivative values and transport equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The standard normed field structure on ℝ, combining its field operations with its norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real normed-field and self-vector-space structures used by differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Promotes a type's addition to homogeneous HAdd.",
      "effect_on_target": "Routes the overloaded sums to the selected addition operation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Promotes a type's multiplication to homogeneous HMul.",
      "effect_on_target": "Routes coefficient products to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Promotes a type's subtraction to homogeneous HSub.",
      "effect_on_target": "Routes the subtraction in w₋ to real subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Builds a commutative subtraction-monoid structure from an additive commutative group, preserving its operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited additive, negation and zero structure in D007 without adding function assumptions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the addition used in the generic transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets the identity requirement of an additive commutative monoid while preserving associative commutative addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the instance path selecting the same addition in D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains the addition and its commutativity from an additive commutative semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the instance path supplying addition in the transport predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition, zero and their identity laws from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible addition and zero for the derivative equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the zero element from an AddZero structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive zero used on the right-hand side of the generic transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition-and-zero data from an AddZeroClass structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the zero and addition used by D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Derives a nontrivially normed field structure from a densely normed field, preserving its normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the required nontrivial norm structure on the real scalar field for HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication preserving zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the instance path defining the real scalar action in D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero from a distributive scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar multiplication used in speed • q_x.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets the zero-detection requirement of an extended normed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inherited structure step that leaves the transport predicate's addition and zero unchanged.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid from an extended seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the underlying addition and zero used in the generic derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets additive commutativity while retaining the extended seminormed additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "An instance conversion preserving the operations available to D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying additive monoid from an extended seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible additive operations and zero for the transport predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two elements of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The differential balances are exact equalities to zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires derivative values to exist at each point. Witnesses are chosen within the point quantifiers, and separately for each conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts and applies the scalar multiplication operation of an HSMul instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms speed • q_x, which is the real product speed q_x in this target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts that a function has a specified derivative at a point, using HasDerivAtFilter with the varying argument approaching that point through its full neighborhood filter and the base point fixed.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires ordinary two-sided real derivatives of the coordinate slices; it does not use a default derivative value for nondifferentiable functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the normed vector space's module structure to scalar multiplication in D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Inequality defined as the negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "The system constructor requires that density is not zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure with negation preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an inherited additive zero for D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A normed additive commutative group, with a metric compatible with the norm of differences.",
      "effect_on_target": "Constrains the generic codomain of D007; the target fixes that codomain to standard ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying additive commutative group from a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies additive group operations required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive commutative group with its induced extended normed additive commutative monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an instance path to the same additive operations and zero in D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group and induced pseudometric of a normed additive commutative group as a seminormed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the compatible seminormed structure needed by NormedSpace and the derivative topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A module over a normed field with scalar multiplication satisfying the norm compatibility bound.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes D007 a real normed-vector-space predicate; no arbitrary space remains quantified in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module underlying a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar action needed to state derivatives and the transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure compatible with a pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the path supplying the usual topology for the derivative assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The standard real normed field has an element whose norm lies between any two strictly ordered nonnegative real bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the nontrivially normed scalar field structure required for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "The inferred multiplicative monoid structure of ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real division-and-inversion structure without imposing additional parameter conditions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The inferred semiring structure of ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the canonical real module and scalar multiplication structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a scalar action preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the scalar operation used by the transport predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the compatible pseudometric from a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the metric-derived topology in which derivative limits are taken.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains zero, negation and the fact that negation fixes zero from a subtraction-and-negation monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inherited structure step supplying zero in the generic transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets the commutativity component of a commutative subtraction monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the subtraction, negation and zero structure used in D007's instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid",
      "meaning": "Builds the subtraction-and-negation structure with negation fixing zero from a subtraction monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible zero and negation through the additive group hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology of a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the neighborhood topology used by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Promotes a scalar multiplication operation to HSMul.",
      "effect_on_target": "Routes speed • q_x to the selected real scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, associativity and commutativity from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive monoid structure needed for modules and scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited addition, negation and subtraction for derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts an additive group's monoid, subtraction and negation structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the operations used by the derivative and transport predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "The assertion that scalar multiplication is jointly continuous in the scalar and the acted-on element.",
      "effect_on_target": "A structural prerequisite of HasDerivAt, supplied by D010 or D011; it does not assert continuity of p or u as functions of two variables.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring operations and laws from a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a compatible real semiring instance for module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains the commutative division-semiring structure of a field, including zero, multiplication, inverse and division.",
      "effect_on_target": "An instance conversion preserving the real arithmetic used by the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "Inv.inv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the unary inverse operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms ρ⁻¹ in the system's second differential equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a compatible multiplication-and-identity structure for real arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "An instance conversion preserving the norm, additive operations and topology used for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the seminormed additive structure supporting real vector-space and derivative instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar field's norm and arithmetic throughout the derivative instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
